title: Symmetric operadic families and the colorwise relative operadic cocone condition
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functor categories, mapping spaces, full subcategories and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], coherent slices with their source projections of [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration], categorical fibrations (Joyal fibrations between quasicategories) of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure], cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], symmetric infinity-operads and active and inert pointed maps of [lem-coef-operadic-approximation-restriction], and active concatenation $\oplus$ of [lem-coef-active-operad-cocartesian-concatenation]. Fix a small quasicategory $S$. An $S$-family of symmetric infinity-operads is a categorical fibration $\pi:M^\otimes\to S\times N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ with the following data conditions. Each fiber $M_s^\otimes\to N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ is a symmetric infinity-operad. Every inert pointed map out of the image of $x\in M_s^\otimes$ has a $\pi$-cocartesian lift within $M_s^\otimes$. For $x$ over $(s,\langle r\rangle)$ and any choice of these lifts $x\to x_i$, $1\leq i\leq r$, over the color projections $\rho_i$, and every $y\in M^\otimes$, the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}
\operatorname{Map}_{M^\otimes}(y,x)&\longrightarrow&\prod_{i=1}^r\operatorname{Map}_{M^\otimes}(y,x_i)\\
\downarrow&&\downarrow\\
\operatorname{Map}_{S\times N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)}(\pi y,\pi x)&\longrightarrow&\prod_{i=1}^r\operatorname{Map}_{S\times N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)}(\pi y,\pi x_i)
\end{array}$$
is a homotopy pullback, with its composition homotopy. At $r=0$ the products are points. An inert edge of a family is a $\pi$-cocartesian edge whose pointed map is inert and whose $S$-edge is an equivalence. A family map to a symmetric infinity-operad $E^\otimes$ is a functor over $N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ preserving these inert edges. For a simplicial subset $K\subseteq S$, a family map on $M_K^\otimes=M^\otimes\times_S K$ is a map over $N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ preserving the inert edges inherited from $M^\otimes$. A correspondence is such a family for $S=\Delta^1$, with endpoint operads $M_0^\otimes,M_1^\otimes$. Write $M^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}$ for the wide simplicial subcategory whose edges project to active pointed maps in $N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$, with no restriction on their $S$-coordinate.

Here are local relative cocone conventions. Let $q:E^\otimes\to O^\otimes$ be a cocartesian fibration and a map of symmetric infinity-operads. For a small simplicial set $J$, an active diagram $D:J\to E^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}$ and a specified active coherent cocone $c:D\to\Delta_J v$, call $c$ operadically $q$-colimiting when, for every $Z\in E^\otimes$ and every color $W\in E^\otimes_{\langle1\rangle}$, restriction along $c\oplus1_Z$ makes the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}
\operatorname{Map}_{E^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}}(v\oplus Z,W)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(J,E^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})}(D\oplus Z,\Delta_J W)\\
\downarrow&&\downarrow\\
\operatorname{Map}_{O^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}}(q(v\oplus Z),qW)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(J,O^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})}(q(D\oplus Z),\Delta_J(qW))
\end{array}$$
a homotopy pullback; the bottom map uses $qc$. A homotopy pullback retains a path between the two images and all higher homotopies, and means equivalence with this path-space pullback. Empty $J$ and the empty tuple $Z$ are allowed. For a correspondence $M^\otimes$, a family map $H:M^\otimes\to E^\otimes$ over a specified family map $g:M^\otimes\to O^\otimes$ satisfies the colorwise relative operadic left Kan condition if, for every color $d\in M_1^\otimes$, its induced active cocone on
$$J_d=M_0^\otimes\times_{M^\otimes}(M^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})_{/d}$$
with source diagram $H$ after projection and apex $H(d)$ is operadically $q$-colimiting. Slices, pullbacks and cocones retain their coherent simplices; no existence of a family, a cocone, or an extension is asserted by these definitions.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q119-ae59d0f75 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item, all six stmt_deps statements, the three citers (extension-boundaries, mapping-cylinder, left-horn-filling) and the unit/chapter. The item cites only Higher Algebra, so the no-SGA lock holds. HA is not archived in literature/ and reviewers have no network, so I could not open the PDF. I checked the clauses against HA Definitions 2.3.2.10, 3.1.1.2, 3.1.2.1-2 and Remark 3.1.1.5 as I know them and against the second reader's page record (pp.253-254, 318-319, 329); the WANTED archive request stands. (1) S-family: requiring each fiber to be an operad, plus inert lifts over (id_s, alpha) and the relative Segal homotopy pullback, is equivalent to HA's conditions (1)-(3). Fiber mapping spaces are homotopy fibers over id_s because pi is a categorical fibration. (2) Inert edges, family maps, maps on M_K and the correspondence match HA; M_act restricts only the Fin_* coordinate. (3) The operadic q-colimit square tests only colours W, after c+1_Z for every Z. This is the fiberwise form of HA's trivial-fibration condition over colours: the strict pullback of left fibrations is already a homotopy pullback. Testing all W would be wrong. The narrowing to cocartesian q is harmless: every citer assumes it, and no target is involved. (4) The colorwise Kan condition with J_d = M_0 x_M (M_act)_{/d} matches HA 3.1.2.2. Edge cases tested: S = point, S empty, r = 0 and 1, J empty, Z empty, identity cocone. Duplicate search: def-coef-operadic-correspondence is the nonsymmetric Delta^op notion (Gepner-Haugseng), a different notion, and no other node defines symmetric families. There are no proof steps and no new nodes; Mathlib has no match. Fix: the statement had a sentence fragment ('...over the color projections rho_i. For every y...'); I merged it into one quantified clause ('..., and every y in M, the square ...') with no change of meaning, in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-six-functors/def-coef-symmetric-operadic-family.json.
